summary: Sanders calls for pausing advanced AI and banning superintelligence, and for public control so that AI’s gains reach working people.

statements.quote: At a time when artificial intelligence and robotics will radically transform our economy, it is imperative that the financial gains from this new technology benefit working families
We need an immediate PAUSE on advanced AI development, and a permanent BAN on superintelligence
Left unchecked, Artificial Intelligence and robotics threatens the jobs, privacy rights and mental health of every man, woman and child in America
statements.venue: Statement, American AI Sovereign Wealth Fund Act

statements.quote: The American people must have the ability to slow it down and make sure that AI benefits humanity, not just the richest people on the planet.
statements.venue: Statement, American AI Sovereign Wealth Fund Act

statements.quote: AI and robotics are creating the most sweeping technological revolution in the history of humanity.
statements.venue: Statement, AI Data Center Moratorium Act
